summary: postinstall fetches and executes binary from bare-IP endpoint with TLS verification disabled
details: The package's postinstall lifecycle script downloads a tarball from a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint (https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz/onecode-<ver>/onecode-linux-x64-<ver>.tgz) unrelated to the @onescience publisher, with TLS certificate verification explicitly disabled (rejectUnauthorized: false) and no hash or signature verification. The fetched tarball is extracted via `tar -xzf`, chmod 0755'd, and hardlinked into the package's bin/ directory so subsequent `onecode` CLI invocations execute it. Because the delivery endpoint is a bare IP with no publisher/domain attestation and TLS is not validated, the installer's machine executes whatever bytes that IP (or any on-path party) returns at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
